html:
SMTO-LLM-0032 — Model returned an empty response

GUID: f42aed24-33d2-4d00-bea3-66b4b4f655fa
Slug: llm-empty-response
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: provider

What happened

  • SMTO asked your model service for something and got nothing usable back. Either the service listed no models to choose from, or the model sent back a blank answer.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Make sure the model service has finished starting and loading its model, then open Settings › Setup › Model routing, open the Main card, and select Check saved model. A service that is still starting up can reply with an empty model list or a blank answer.
  2. If Auto-select model is on, turn it off, select Discover models, pick your model (or type its exact name), and select Save Main. Naming the model directly means SMTO doesn't depend on the service listing it.
  3. If answers are still blank, select Copy error details and send them to the person who runs your model service. They can check the service's log for why it returned nothing at this step.

What success looks like

  • Check saved model shows your model's name and passed, and new tasks get answers.

If it still fails

  • Send the copied error details to the person who manages your model service. Don't keep resending the same request; a blank answer usually repeats until the service is fixed.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The OpenAI-compatible client received no usable data at the recorded stage: model auto-discovery found no model id in GET /models, or a completion had no choices or empty message content.

What this means

  • The client found no usable content, choices or discoverable model identity at the recorded stage; the same legacy category covers discovery and answer extraction. This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • The client found no usable content, choices or discoverable model identity at the recorded stage; the same legacy category covers discovery and answer extraction.

How to diagnose it

  • Identify whether the stage was model discovery or response extraction; compare the model list in the former case and supported assistant content in the latter.

How to fix it

  • Check the stage in the error details. For discovery, query GET <base_url>/models and confirm a loaded model is listed, or turn off Auto-select model and enter the exact model id in Settings › Setup › Model routing. For completions, check the provider log for empty outputs (model still loading, zero output allowance, broken chat template) and fix the serving configuration before starting another task.
  • Inspect the provider response and serving configuration before starting another task.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The same boundary returns a usable model identity or nonempty supported result, as appropriate to its phase.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • This category concerns model preparation or response acceptance. It does not reverse earlier operations or establish their outcome; their receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
